name: Question 3
problem:
Describe the set $S={12,9,6,3,...}$ using a constructive definition.

$$
15-3n
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that the elements of our set

$$
12,\,9,\,6,\,3,\,…
$$

form an arithmetic sequence with common difference $d=-3:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =-3 \\  & =9-12 \\  & =6-9 \\  & =⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the $n$th term ${a}_{n}$ of our sequence for $n\in N$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)\cdot d \\  & =12+(n-1)\cdot (-3) \\  & =12-3n+3 \\  & =15-3n.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can define our set using a constructive definition as follows:

$$
S={15-3n\,:\,n\in N}
$$
